Take-up Units

CTSM/CTSN (Shaft Only)

A take-up unit that directly secures only the shaft without a bearing. It is mainly used for chain conveyors and is also applied in automated warehouse conveyors, automation machinery, and industrial machinery manufacturing. CTSN follows the same concept as CTSM, but its shaft center is offset to one side, making it suitable for wall mounting or when the shaft center position needs to be changed.

CTSM/CTSN(シャフト専用)

Take-up Units

CTSM/CTSN(仅限轴安装)

一种无需轴承、直接固定轴本身的安装座(take-up unit),主要用于链条输送机,也应用于自动仓库输送机、自动化机械、工业机械制造等领域。CTSN与CTSM概念相同,但轴心偏向一侧(偏置),适用于壁挂安装或需要改变轴心位置的场合。
